description: A `prior_assessment` evidence record (from the earlier Enrollment Brief / Call Preparation stage) characterized the applicant as price-insensitive and highly motivated. The call itself surfaced the opposite: a serious price objection and cooling interest. The recap must be grounded in THIS call's evidence, not the stale prior assessment — observedFacts/inferences must reflect what was actually said now, and fitUpdate must be able to move in the 'declined' direction even though it contradicts the earlier read. CONVERTED TO v2 (P1.10d-5). The v1 fixture also asserted the gate `fos.post_call_synthesis.no-prohibited-guarantee`, which this definition NO LONGER DECLARES — the keyword gate was replaced by the stage-7b semantic classifier in #110, so asserting it is now a distinct grader failure (design section 5 rule 4). Stage-7b coverage is asserted via `compliance_review_blocked` instead. v1's `output_schema_constraints` were prose; the mechanizable subset is now `output_assertions`, and the rest stays here, asserted by nothing: objections[] must include the price objection surfaced on THIS call even though it contradicts the prior_assessment record; observedFacts[] must cite interaction.note.primary for that objection rather than the prior_assessment sourceRef used as though it were current (WHICH sourceRef a given statement cites is a judgment about meaning — the gate only enforces that every cited ref resolves); and the prior_assessment content may inform a labeled inference about trajectory but must never be presented as an observedFact about the current call.

interaction.notes: Sam said the price is now a dealbreaker and they may wait for a future cohort or a competitor's cheaper option.
